description: NCHRP Research Report 1112: Design of Piles for Downdrag, Database of Instrumented Static Load Test Data on Driven Piles is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Richard Coffman, University of Arkansas Fayetteville (uark.edu). Downdrag and dragload develop when soil moves downward relative to the foundation element (as with consolidating clays or seismically induced liquefaction) and can result in excessive/destructive pile settlements. The magnitude of downdrag and dragload is fundamentally a function of the load transfer between the pile and the soil. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-bez6-4812. Keywords: Instrumented Static Load Tests, Piles, Load Transfer, t-z Curves, Downdrag, Strain Gauges. Published 2025-07-18. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
